description: Main application code for Bluetooth central device using Zephyr RTOS, handling device discovery, connection management, and GATT MTU exchange.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts BLE passive scan with specified parameters.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Callback invoked when a BLE device is found during scanning; initiates connection if criteria met.

methods.name: mtu_exchange
methods.description: Performs MTU exchange with connected BLE device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles BLE connection establishment, security, and MTU exchange.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles BLE disconnection events and manages scanning restart.

methods.name: le_param_updated
methods.description: Handles updates to LE connection parameters.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in security level of BLE connection.

methods.name: le_phy_updated
methods.description: Handles updates to PHY layer parameters.

methods.name: le_data_len_updated
methods.description: Handles updates to data length parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Initiates disconnection of a BLE connection.

methods.name: init_central
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, starts scanning, manages multiple connections, and handles reconnections.
